    56  namespace MeasureTheory

    58  variable {α : Type*} {C : Set (Set α)} {s t : Set α}
    59  
    60  /-- A semi-ring of sets `C` is a family of sets containing `∅`, stable by intersection and such that
    61  for all `s, t ∈ C`, `s \ t` is equal to a disjoint union of finitely many sets in `C`. -/
    62  structure IsSetSemiring (C : Set (Set α)) : Prop where
    63    empty_mem : ∅ ∈ C
    64    inter_mem : ∀ s ∈ C, ∀ t ∈ C, s ∩ t ∈ C
    65    sdiff_eq_sUnion' : ∀ s ∈ C, ∀ t ∈ C,
    66      ∃ I : Finset (Set α), ↑I ⊆ C ∧ PairwiseDisjoint (I : Set (Set α)) id ∧ s \ t = ⋃₀ I
    67  
    68  /-- A ring of sets `C` is a family of sets containing `∅`, stable by union and set difference.
    69  It is then also stable by intersection (see `IsSetRing.inter_mem`). -/
    70  structure IsSetRing (C : Set (Set α)) : Prop where
    71    empty_mem : ∅ ∈ C
    72    union_mem ⦃s t : Set α⦄ : s ∈ C → t ∈ C → s ∪ t ∈ C
    73    sdiff_mem ⦃s t : Set α⦄ : s ∈ C → t ∈ C → s \ t ∈ C
    74  
    75  namespace IsSetRing
    76  
    77  lemma inter_mem (hC : IsSetRing C) (hs : s ∈ C) (ht : t ∈ C) : s ∩ t ∈ C := by
    78    rw [← sdiff_sdiff_right_self]; exact hC.sdiff_mem hs (hC.sdiff_mem hs ht)
    79  
    80  lemma isSetSemiring (hC : IsSetRing C) : IsSetSemiring C where

    83    sdiff_eq_sUnion' := by
